From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@shipstack.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API eval - would like a quick demo

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for the Hosted API trial this morning (ShipStack account). Curious if someone can do a quick 20-30m walkthrough of the API and recommended evaluation plan for our use case (real-time parcel status enrichment + generating customer-friendly summaries).

Availability this week: Tue/Wed morning PT, or Thursday afternoon PT. Also would like to include our eng lead, Elena Morris (elena@shipstack.com).

Quick context: we ingest webhook events from carriers and want to build an on-premise safe prompts set; main goals are latency under 150ms for short payloads, and an embedding pipeline for deduping carrier messages.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Integrations
ShipStack

Hi Samir - great to meet you, and thanks for signing up.

I looped in Aditya (our SDR/solutions coordinator) to help align schedules and make sure we cover the eval checklist you need. We can do 30 minutes and tailor it to the latency/embeddings topics you called out. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 11/18 11:00-11:30
- Wed 11/19 09:00-09:30
- Thu 11/20 14:00-14:30

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on our calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30m (we'll send a Zoom link).

Agenda suggestion:
- Quick intros + high-level goals (5m)
- Hosted API capabilities that map to latency & embeddings (10m)
- Next steps: eval plan, test data, and timelines (10m)

Aditya - can you pick the slot that works for Samir & Elena and create the invite with the evaluation plan attached?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0178
